
Number 0 is reserved: `covers: NO-SPEC` names it, and a ref to it is refused as the no-governing-spec sentinel. A number whose spec was folded into another spec is never re-imported and never given to a new document. A citation of it is read as the successor that now holds its text, and is updated to the successor only when the surrounding text is revised for another reason. Resolution does not redirect: a superseded document stays readable at its own number, and a number that holds no document resolves to nothing. The one exception is a retired ADR: `<KEY>-ADR-<n>` resolves to the spec in that project whose `docs.former_adr` is `n`, and `lode show` prints a one-line notice naming the successor before its text. An ADR number is never given out again. WL-SPEC-2 is the one reused number: it names the Glossary, and a citation of spec 002 written before September 2026 means the GitHub App design, now WL-SPEC-74#sec-9.
